note: Barnes County park in the wooded Sheyenne River hills, 4 miles south and 1 mile east of Kathryn on ND 46, on the Sheyenne River Valley National Scenic Byway. The electric sites sit together by the registration area; the non-electric sites are spread up a valley along a spring-fed stream crossed by footbridges. Hiking trails, a kayak dock, playground and reservable shelters. --Claude
summary: County pages, brochure, reservation rules and park map read: 34 sites (16 electric 20-50 A, 18 non-electric for small campers/tents), $25 electric ($20 non-electric), $5 reservation fee, RoverPass only (honor box for a late single night), 7-night max, open May-Oct. Groups written; base rate 20 -> 25 (non-electric sites are mapped for small campers/tents). Not waterfront and pin stand.
flags: FEES: nightly_low 20 -> 25. The park map labels the non-electric sites 'Small Campers/Tents' and the county calls them 'perfect for tents and small campers', so the cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome is shown to fit is an electric site at $25.
